account_id.description: The account, to trace its figures in the general ledger.

amounts.description: One per column, signed as the statement shows them: income, liabilities and equity as positive credits, expenses and assets as positive debits; the trial balance keeps the ledger's sign, debits positive.

function.description: Its function: COGS, R&D, S&M, G&A or Other.

name.description: Its name, as the chart has it today (FR-RPT-08).

percents.description: The P&L only: each column's % of that column's revenue (RND-PERCENT); empty where the revenue is zero, and for other statements.

items.description: A % of revenue to one decimal, such as 12.5; empty for none.
